description: This file defines data structures, templates, and macros for network traffic annotation, including hash computation, annotation tags, partial annotations, and related utilities used for tracking and managing network traffic annotations in Chromium.

classes.name: NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Represents a network traffic annotation with a unique ID hash code, supporting comparison and special 'NotReached' state.

classes.name: PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Represents a partial network traffic annotation with a unique ID hash code and optional completing ID hash code for debug purposes.

classes.name: MutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: A mutable version of NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag, allowing validation and reset of the annotation state.

classes.name: MutablePartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: A mutable version of PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag, allowing validation and reset of the partial annotation state.

methods.name: recursive_hash
methods.description: Computes a compile-time hash code of a string recursively.

methods.name: DefineNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Creates a NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag from a unique ID and protobuf text, using a compile-time hash.

methods.name: DefinePartialNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Creates a PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag with optional completing ID, for partial annotations.

methods.name: CompleteNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Completes a partial annotation into a full NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag.

methods.name: BranchedCompleteNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Creates a branched complete annotation with a group ID.

methods.name: CreateMutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
methods.description: Factory function to create a mutable network traffic annotation tag.
